__faion_header__.purpose: Example scorecard rubric with one scored call, conforming to content/02-output-contract.xml
__faion_header__.consumes: ICP criteria, closed-deal history, discovery call notes

version_reason: budget anchors moved from 10k/30k to 15k/40k EUR after Q1 close data showed no closed deal under 15k

axes.name: fit
anchors: outside ICP: none of industry, size or service line match
meets all 3 ICP criteria and asks for our core service line

axes.name: budget
anchors: no budget named or under 15k EUR per year
15k-40k EUR per year stated on the call
above 40k EUR per year stated on the call

axes.name: urgency
anchors: start this month or a named deadline within 30 days

axes.name: decision_maker
anchors: authority not discussed, or an individual contributor
manager who must get sign-off from a named person
owner, partner or director who confirmed they approve the spend

threshold_rule: score at or above decision_threshold advances; below is rejected or nurtured

axis_scores.evidence: logistics SME, 120 staff, asked for paid search management: all three ICP criteria
'we have around 2,500 a month for this' = 30k EUR per year
'peak season starts in June, we need campaigns live by 1 June'
marketing manager; 'I need to run the number past our CFO, Eva' - authority not confirmed on the call
